claims.scope: ERC-4337 UserOp signature validation in AtomWallet._validateSignature via validateUserOp

preconditions.text: A valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after any executed UserOp.; Any observer of a valid owner signature can derive a high-s counterpart with s' = curve_order - s and v' = v XOR 1, whose recovered address is identical to the original signer.; High-s signatures are technically valid ECDSA and a high-s counterpart of any valid owner signature is constructable against any live wallet.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: On a signature mismatch, validateUserOp should return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting, so the EntryPoint can distinguish signature failure from a wallet bug.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: In EntryPoint implementations where validation reverts propagate to the outer handleOps call, the bundler's entire batch transaction fails on-chain, causing gas loss.
